name: Sushi nigiri (salmon)
style: low-poly, flat colours; a salmon slice draped over a rounded rice block, white fat lines in a chevron; 0.03 m tall makes it 0.076 m long and 0.035 m wide, a real nigiri

source.author: Quaternius
source.note: Wave-1 row 188 named Quaternius static models on poly.pizza (Cloudflare challenge, off limits); the same artist's Ultimate Food Pack (Oct 2019) is on OpenGameArt as 'Low Poly Food Pack', CC0. Rendered against Kenney Food Kit `sushi-salmon` (a flat box slab on a box of rice, which reads as a block): Quaternius `Sushi_Nigiri1` won, a slice draped over a rounded rice bed with chevron fat lines. Neither candidate has a nori band. Colours (noon): rice in practical with a sky shade as the onigiri, so they share a plate; the salmon in accent with an iris shade at a low threshold (0.1), so the shade only rims the slice's underside. The fat lines are the pack's white material and land on rice. Static, no clips.
